item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=How+do+RLHF+minimax+game+frameworks+account+for+long-term+preference+stability+in+autonomous+agent+alignment%3F&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.7118021\", \"title\": [\"Purchased Epistemic Erasure: AI Alignment, RLHF, and the Exploitation of Global Preference Labor\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>The alignment of artificial intelligence, operationalized through reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), is marketed as a mechanism for teaching models global human preference. This paper argues that the underlying geographic arbitrage of preference labor achieves the exact opposite: the extraction of strict conformity to a WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) demographic standard. By outsourcing annotation to the Global South at a fraction of the cost, developers exploit the active suppression of local capability and context. Platform algorithms, scoring mechanisms, and the threat of uncompensated work compel annotators to abandon independent judgment and supply the cheapest simulation of Western expectation. We define this dynamic as purchased epistemic erasure. The resulting models act as mirrors of a single dominant culture masquerading as windows to the world. We conclude that pluralistic alignment-which decentralizes architecture and compensates annotator disagreement-poses a strict financial cost that firms seeking global authority refuse to pay, exposing current alignment not as an accident of scale, but as an engineered economics of silence.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7118021\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.6215338\", \"title\": [\"The Alignment Fingerprint: RLHF Conditioning Creates Universal Compliance-Stability Tension Detectable Through Behavioral Profiling\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>Post-training alignment procedures-including Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and supervised fine-tuning on instruction-response pairs-leave a detectable behavioral fingerprint in language models: a systematic tension between instruction compliance and belief stability that is universal across alignment-conditioned models and ab…
